title: The Developing MallWorld
content: Does anyone else have parts of their Mall World take place in a developing country? I've lived in developing countries for a large part of my life, so it's not super surprising to have a dream with that as the backdrop. Especially the last month I've had a lot of dreams that seem far more vivid than usual, and take place in the urban part of a developing country. Everything is always outdoors (as is the actual IRL mall sometimes), sometimes walking along train tracks, sometimes in a jumble of cement block buildings. I wouldn't even find it noteworthy if it wasn't so consistent.
